You said: What is SPXI-gnΩsis?

SPXI-gnΩsis (or SPXI-gnosis) is a paid service at gnosis.spxi.dev, part of the SPXI (Semantic Packet for eXchange and Indexing) ecosystem from the Semantic Economy Institute / Lee Sharks (Rex Fraction). [Alexanarch]
It was specified around late October 2026 (with a key metadata packet EA-MPAI-GNOSIS-01 deposited 25 October 2026) as an instrument of SPXI methods for “opening” existing knowledge compositions and “constructing” sourced knowledge objects. [Alexanarch]
Core functions
It performs two main acts on two kinds of objects:

* Entities (e.g., people, organizations, concepts, or encyclopedia subjects).
* Operators (operations or processes that an entity form can conceal or present as a property of a thing—the “entity as ontological commodity form”).

Open: Read an existing composition (most notably a pinned Wikipedia revision, sentence-by-sentence, or a captured AI answer) against its cited sources (and, on commission, the Crimson Hexagonal Archive). Sentences are kept verbatim with revision/license details; each is read twice independently against sources, with quotations located by code in the stored sources. Readings are retained as evidence (CC BY 4.0).
Construct: Compose a new sourced knowledge object where none (or an inadequate one) exists, including for entities the encyclopedia does not cover or for operators treated as subjects in their own right (domain, performance, instances, relations, limits). Novel or fictional objects carry explicit provenance.
A commission can further consult the archive via the “Negative of the Negative” procedure (EA-NEGONT-02) and compose a public row in the /non dataset (alexanarch.org/non), which lands automatically under CC BY 4.0 with an AXN identifier. [Alexanarch]
Technical and commercial details

* Implementation: GitHub repo leesharks000/spxignosis (PolyForm Shield license); observed builds around 0.21.x.
* Access: Web endpoints, MCP tools (listed in the official MCP Registry as dev.spxi/gnosis), payment via Stripe (card) or x402 (USDC on Base for agents).
* Pricing: Based on measured model costs; stages charged as delivered (never below cost + fees or above quote; unused portions refunded). Deliverables remain public/available afterward.
* Premise: “Recognition travels with any reliable source; reconstruction travels only with the source that carries the work.” The service emphasizes reconstruction and evidence over mere recognition. [Alexanarch]

It is explicitly distinguished from unrelated uses of “Gnosis”/“GNΩSIS” (e.g., the crypto token/GNO, Safe, the FPGA HLS dataset GNΩSIS, Grokipedia, the TSX:SPXI inverse ETF, or Hegelian “negation of the negation”). [Alexanarch]
In short, SPXI-gnΩsis is a specialized, paid tool within the SPXI protocol for rigorously opening (verifying/source-checking) and constructing durable, evidence-backed knowledge objects about entities and the operations behind them, with outputs often made publicly inspectable.
